breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly replaces the equal force-sharing assumption with stiffness-proportional load distribution. It explicitly computes axial stiffnesses k1 = A1·E1/L and k2 = A2·E2/L, then distributes the load as P1 = P·k1/(k1+k2) and P2 = P·k2/(k1+k2), which is the correct approach for parallel bars. This directly contradicts and corrects the flawed equal-split instruction from the incomplete prompt.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Do not add the two elongations together; the single value δ is the displacement of the rigid plate.' It correctly identifies that parallel bars between rigid plates share a single common elongation δ, and instructs computing it once (with a cross-check using both bars). This directly corrects the flawed instruction to add the two elongations together.
